paper_title: Can a permutation be sorted by best short swaps?
statement: to recognize a happy permutation and sort it with the fewest short swaps. We also gave a new algorithm to recognize a lucky permutation with O(n) steps, which improves the time complexity of O(n2 ) [9]. The complexity of minimum sorting by short swaps problem remains open. The best known approximation ratio of this problem is 2, which was given by Heath and Vergara [9]. It is interesting that if we can get a smaller approximation ratio for this problem.
